facts.business: The Company is engaged in the business of manufacture and export of cotton yarn and grey fabrics, and trading in the same commodity.

auditor.name: Vivekanandan Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material uncertainty exists that Company is not capable of meeting its liabilities as and when they fall due within a period of one year from the balance sheet date; company has not obtained any report from actuary in respect of gratuity payable; Secretarial Auditors have not filed report in Form ADT-4 with the Central Government.

key_risks: Manufacturing operations suspended during the financial year 2025-26 due to market volatility
Material uncertainty regarding ability to meet liabilities as they fall due within one year from balance sheet date
Dependence on related parties for unsecured financial assistance up to Rs.1.00 Crore
facts.related_party_note: Approval sought for related party transactions with Mr. R. Veeramani, Mr. S. R. Asaithambi, and Mr. S. R. Kumar for receiving unsecured financial assistance up to Rs.1.00 Crore for operational purposes. Company is in compliance with Section 177 and Section 188 of the Act for all transactions with related parties and details have been disclosed in the Standalone financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
